_doc: Plain-language names and explanations. Every [data-tip="id"] in the UI is looked up here: `short` is the tooltip/popover (one sentence), `long` is shown on the Help page. Item types are keyed 'type:<id>'. Rarities ('rarity:<tier>') and mutations ('mutation:<id>') are generated from their own data files. Add a term by adding an object; add it to the Help glossary automatically by giving it a `name`.

money.name: Money
money.short: Your coins. Earned when a seller sells what your drills make. Spend it on rolls, upgrades and expansions.
money.long: Money is the main currency. It is earned from the items on your base (see Income), by selling items, and from rewards. Spending it never takes more than you have.

income.name: Income
income.short: Money per second your base earns right now. Click it to see where it comes from.
income.long: Income is the money per second your placed items produce once everything is added up. Open the income breakdown (click the Income number) to see every item and multiplier.

level.name: Level
level.short: Your progress level. Rolling and selling give XP; each level pays a reward and raises luck a little.
level.long: Levels never end. Every level pays a reward (money, free rolls, backpack space and more) exactly once, and each level also adds a little luck.

xp.name: XP
xp.short: Experience toward the next level. Rolls and sales give XP.
xp.long: XP fills the bar toward your next level. Bigger rewards and generators can multiply it.

luck.name: Luck
luck.short: Makes rarer items more likely. ×2 luck means a rare item is twice as likely.
luck.long: Luck multiplies your chance of rolling rarer items. It comes from your level, shop upgrades, boosters, clover shrines and prestige bonuses, and it never stops growing.

region.name: Region
region.short: Each rebirth moves you to a new region with its own look. Region 1 is where you start.
region.long: Every rebirth takes you to the next region: a new theme, new names and a fresh start with permanent bonuses.

rarity.name: Rarity
rarity.short: How rare an item is. Rarer items are worth far more. Shown by name, icon and border, not just colour.
rarity.long: Rarity tiers run from Common upward and never end. A rarer tier is much less likely to roll and much stronger when it does.

tier.name: Tier
tier.short: The number behind a rarity name. Higher tier = rarer and stronger.
tier.long: Tier is the rarity as a number. Fusing three same-tier items can make one item of the next tier.

mutation.name: Mutation
mutation.short: A bonus trait on an item, like Golden or Shiny. It multiplies one or more of its stats.
mutation.long: Mutations are rolled with the item. Higher rarity items can carry more of them. The Refinery can re-roll, move or combine mutations.

hybrid.name: Hybrid
hybrid.short: An item that has a small second effect on top of its main one.
hybrid.long: A hybrid has a secondary effect (multiply, add, refine or sell) at 40% strength.

variant.name: Variant
variant.short: A named version of an item whose stats are a little higher or lower than normal.
variant.long: Variants jitter each stat between 0.8× and 1.3× and give the item a name word.

practice.name: Practice item
practice.short: Given by the tutorial to practise with. Worth $0.
practice.long: Practice items help you finish the tutorial. They cannot be sold for money.

pity.name: Pity
pity.short: A safety net: after enough rolls without a good item, the next roll is guaranteed one.
pity.long: Soft pity guarantees at least a 1-in-8 result after 30 rolls; hard pity guarantees at least a 1-in-120 result after 200 rolls.

freeRolls.name: Free rolls
freeRolls.short: Rolls that cost nothing. One recharges every couple of minutes, up to a cap.
freeRolls.long: Free rolls recharge over time (the timer pauses when you are at the cap) and are also given as rewards.

backpack.name: Backpack
backpack.short: Where rolled items wait until you place, sell or fuse them. When it is full, rolling stops.
backpack.long: The backpack has limited space. Buy a bigger one in the Shop, sell extras or fuse items.

sellValue.name: Sell value
sellValue.short: Money you get for selling this item. It is never more than half of what a roll cost.
sellValue.long: Selling pays at most 50% of the roll price at the level the item was found, so rolling just to sell can never print money.

fuse.name: Fuse
fuse.short: Merge 3 to 10 same-tier items into one, possibly of the next tier.
fuse.long: More items and identical items raise the chance (up to 90%). A failed fuse still gives you one item of the same tier.

rate.name: Rate
rate.short: How many units a dropper makes per second.
rate.long: A dropper makes units. Each unit is worth its Value, and sellers cash them in.

value.name: Value
value.short: How much money each unit from a dropper is worth.
value.long: Value is the worth of one unit before multipliers.

cap.name: Throughput
cap.short: The most units per second this belt can carry. Extra units are lost.
cap.long: Conveyors pass units along. If more arrive than the throughput allows, the surplus is wasted.

add.name: + per unit
add.short: Adds a fixed amount of value to every unit that passes through.
add.long: Upgraders add value to each unit before multipliers are applied.

mult.name: Multiplier
mult.short: Multiplies the value of every unit that passes through it.
mult.long: Multipliers in a chain multiply together, so a few good ones in a row are very powerful.

refine.name: Refine
refine.short: Boosts the units that pass through, up to a limit of units per second.
refine.long: Refiners multiply value, but only for the part of the flow they can handle.

sell.name: Sell bonus
sell.short: How much more this seller pays, up to a limit of units per second.
sell.long: Sellers cash units in. Their bonus applies up to their selling speed limit.

aura.name: Speed aura
aura.long: A dynamo speeds up the droppers directly next to it (up, down, left, right).

luckStat.name: Luck bonus
luckStat.short: Adds to your luck while this item is on your base. Several add together.
luckStat.long: Clover shrines add to your luck; they stack by addition, not multiplication.

xpStat.name: XP bonus
xpStat.short: Adds to the XP you earn while this item is on your base.
xpStat.long: Lamps raise the XP you gain from rolls and sales.

dmg.name: Damage
dmg.short: How much damage one shot does. Higher tiers hit far harder.
dmg.long: Turrets and weapons deal this much damage per shot to monsters.

range.name: Range
range.short: How far this can shoot, in tiles.
range.long: Monsters inside the range get shot. Turrets near the middle cover more of the base.

rof.name: Shots per second
rof.short: How many shots it fires each second.
rof.long: Damage per second is damage times shots per second.

special.name: Special effect
special.short: An extra effect: crit, splash, chain, pierce, slow or burn.
special.long: Crit sometimes doubles damage, splash hits nearby enemies, chain jumps between enemies, pierce goes through, slow and burn apply over time.

dtype.name: Damage type
dtype.short: Physical, fire, ice, electric or void. Some monsters resist a type; void ignores resistance.
dtype.long: Enemies resist or are weak to damage types. Mix them.

blocked.name: Blocked
blocked.short: This item's output goes nowhere: the next cell does not accept units.
blocked.long: Droppers, belts and others pass units to the cell they face. If that cell is empty, an edge or something that cannot take units, the units are lost.

wave.name: Wave
wave.short: A group of monsters that attacks your base. Waves come about every minute from level 4.
wave.long: Turrets and weapons defend automatically. Losing a wave costs a little money, never items.

boss.name: Boss
boss.short: An optional tough fight with a big drop: a weapon with a unique mutation.
boss.long: Bosses have special moves. You can leave any time; there is only a short cooldown.

rebirth.name: Rebirth
rebirth.short: Restart your run for permanent bonuses and a new region.
rebirth.long: Rebirth resets money, items and the base, and keeps your level, rewards and prestige currency.

prestigeCurrency.name: Prestige currency
prestigeCurrency.short: Earned by rebirthing. Gives a permanent bonus and buys upgrades in the tree.
prestigeCurrency.long: The more run money you have when you rebirth, the more you earn.

speed.name: Game speed
speed.short: How fast the game runs. Faster speeds unlock as you progress. It never affects offline progress.
speed.long: 1× is normal. Slower speeds are always available; faster ones are unlocked by levels and rebirths.

fps.name: FPS
fps.short: Frames per second: how smoothly the game is drawing.
fps.long: Lower the graphics quality or raise the pixel size in Settings if it is low.

dropper.name: Dropper
dropper.short: Makes units that are worth money. The start of every production line.

conveyor.name: Conveyor
conveyor.short: Carries units to the next cell. It has a speed limit.

multiplier.name: Multiplier
multiplier.short: Multiplies the value of units passing through.

refiner.name: Refiner
refiner.short: Boosts the value of units passing through, up to a limit.

seller.name: Seller
seller.short: Turns units into money. Every line needs one at its end.

upgrader.name: Upgrader
upgrader.short: Adds value to every unit passing through.

generator.name: Generator
generator.short: Gives a bonus just by being on the base: luck, XP or faster neighbours.

turret.name: Turret
turret.short: Shoots monsters that attack your base. Needs no line.

weapon.name: Weapon
weapon.short: Gear you equip (not place). Shoots monsters automatically, or by hand in manual control.
